Game 1 of 3, stage 5 of 8: the table is talking about A05's crew for stage 5 (A01, A02, A05) before the vote. Damaged stages: 1 of 3. Audit used.
The game: a convoy crosses 8 stages. Of the 6 seats, 2 are secret saboteurs who know each other; the others are loyal and know only their own role. Each stage a lead (it moves one seat on every stage, also after a lost vote) proposes a crew of the stage's size (by stage: 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4). The table talks (each seat may speak 2 times a stage), then every seat votes yes or no on its confidence in the lead's crew; the votes are shown once all are in. If strictly more than half vote no, the lead's term ends: the next seat leads and names a crew that goes out without a vote. Every crew member then plays one card face down, safe or damage. Loyal seats can only play safe. A saboteur may play damage, but at most once in 3 stages. Only the number of damage cards is revealed, never who played them; one damage card damages the stage.
